SECRET
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
File No. 62606
No. S. B. D.
S. 5, Special Branch, Station,
REPORT
Date Nov. 17, 1939.

Subject Book Pirating in Shanghai

Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I. Golder.

Reliable information has been obtained that recently
certain committee members of the British Women's Association
approached Kelly & Walsh's, Booksellers, for copies of the
"St. John's Ambulance Manual," an official copyrighted
publication. Upon being informed of the price, the
fact that the aforementioned company had only three copies
and that it would take some 14 days to obtain supplies from
Hongkong, the ladies in question stated they could not wait
that long as training in ambulance work was scheduled to
start immediately.

Subsequently one of the ladies approached a
Chinese printer and had, it is stated, 200 copies of the
"Manual" printed locally.

It should here be stated that the "Manual" in
question does not cost what is actually charged for it by
the St. John's Ambulance Association, the excess over cost
reverting to the Association.

The position of the ladies concerned for a few days
was very delicate but I understand that a certain very high
personage, who had been informed of the breach of copyright,
has suggested that a letter should be addressed to the
St. John's Ambulance Association, offering to forward the
equivalent of the sum which would have accrued to it had
the copies been genuine.

The matter did not reach the stage of legal action
nor, I understand, will such action be taken, but the view
is taken that if and when the representations now being
made to the Chinese Government come to fruition, it would

事由 上海书籍盗版案

由警司高尔德（Golder）撰写并呈报。

据可靠消息获悉，近期英国妇女协会（British Women's Association）的某些委员向凯利与沃尔什书店（Kelly & Walsh's, Booksellers）求购《圣约翰救护手册》（"St. John's Ambulance Manual"），该出版物为享有官方版权之刊物。在得知书价、上述公司仅剩三本存货以及从香港进货需时约14天后，前述女士们表示无法等待如此之久，因为救护工作培训计划立即开始。

随后，其中一位女士接触了一家中国印刷商，据称在当地印制了200本该《手册》。

此处需说明，《手册》的实际成本并不等于圣约翰救护协会（St. John's Ambulance Association）所定售价，超出成本部分的收益归该协会所有。

涉事女士们在数日内的处境十分微妙，但据悉，某位已获悉此侵权事件的高层人士建议致函圣约翰救护协会，提出支付相当于若购买正版书籍该协会本可获得的金额。

此事未进入法律诉讼阶段，据我所知也不会采取此类行动，但各方认为，如果及当目前向中国政府提出的交涉取得成果时，若该国政府能够证明存在英国国民在中国从事盗版而未受起诉的案件，将

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处处长办公室 1939年11月21日）
